inputs.label: Super Smash Bros. Melee disc image (NTSC-U 1.02)
inputs.help: Your own disc image of Melee, USA version 1.02, as .iso, .gcm, .ciso or .rvz.

steps.text: Open Xelee from Library > Unknown Sources. Choose the disc image in the file picker and let it verify. The first start builds shaders for a few minutes; press Play to skip it.

notes: Releases are all pre-releases, so GitHub has no latest release. The same release also has Xelee-Android-arm64.apk, which is not the Quest build. The launcher checks the image against Redump.
